html.html:
What value of w makes this multiplication sentence true?

Hint: Use properties of multiplication.

105 · (945 · 827) = (105 · 945) · w


w =

What value of w makes this multiplication sentence true?

Hint: Use properties of multiplication.

105 · (945 · 827) = (105 · 945) · w


w =

content.html:
Associative property:
You can group the factors in any way without changing the result.

To find w, use properties of multiplication to make both sides of the equation look the same.

The associative property says you can group the factors in any way without changing the result.

105 · (945 · 827)
 = 
(105 · 945) · w

Apply the associative property
(105 · 945) · 827
 = 
(105 · 945) · w
Apply the associative property

Now match up the two sides of the equation.

(105 · 945) · 827
 = 
(105 · 945) · w

So, w = 827.

So, the missing value is 206.
